description: Ghana - Electricity Customers in Southern Ghana is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by Electricity Company of Ghana (World Bank Group). This dataset consists of Customer that are connected to the grid in southern sector of Ghana. Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG), the agency that oversees the southern sector power distribution provided this dataset. This dataset was last updated in June 2014. Citation: Negawatt challenge. Coverage: Ghana. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
